web.marketplace: Community Marketplace for AI Agent Plugins
web.heroDescription: HarnessHub turns plugin sources, versions, permissions, compatibility and licensing into a registry people can actually evaluate.
web.registryFirstDescription: This phase reads manually allowlisted DSH sources through immutable GitHub and npm evidence. Community and payment features are intentionally absent.
web.searchPlaceholder: Search name, description, author, tag, or category
web.tryDifferentSearch: Try another keyword, tag, or category.
web.principleOneBody: Structured plugin evidence instead of an unfiltered repository list.
web.principleTwoBody: Transparent roles and rules, introduced only when their phase is ready.
web.principleThreeBody: Browsing stays open. Trust labels keep one precise, auditable meaning.
web.footerPositioning: Community Marketplace for AI Agent Plugins

desktop.scope: A local DSH contract fixture can be started and stopped. Real DSH, Agent, and model calls remain blocked.
desktop.title: Discover DSH plugins and public ecosystem candidates.
desktop.description: Search verified plugins and automatically discovered candidates with clear source, version, compatibility, and risk information. Users may choose to install plugins with pinned DSH Bundle evidence.
desktop.registrySnapshotNotice: Using the read-only Registry snapshot shipped with HarnessHub. Public browsing remains available without sign-in or the backend service.
desktop.discoverySummary: Merged {{count}} publicly discovered candidates. Unverified plugins with pinned DSH Bundle evidence require two explicit risk confirmations before installation.
desktop.discoveryFailed: Public plugin discovery is temporarily unavailable. Existing plugins and candidate records are unaffected.
desktop.marketplaceEmpty: No plugins match the current filters.
desktop.selectPlugin: Select a plugin to inspect its source and security information

agent.title: Agent Workspace
agent.description: See the real local Runtime, conversation entry point, task state, and activity together. Model calls remain managed by the DSH workspace.
agent.conversationEmpty: Start DSH and open its local workspace to create conversations. HarnessHub never sends content silently on your behalf.
agent.inputPlaceholder: Describe the task you want the Agent to complete…
agent.sendUnavailable: HarnessHub never sends content directly; continue in the DSH workspace
agent.workspaceOpenFailed: The local DSH workspace could not be opened. Confirm the Runtime is running, then try again.
agent.noTaskBody: When real DSH is connected, running tasks, input requests, and completion states will appear here.
agent.safetyBody: HarnessHub only starts local DSH. DSH continues to own model, Agent, tool, and permission confirmation.

dashboard.title: Your AI Agent workspace
dashboard.description: Discover trusted plugins, understand your local Runtime, and manage DSH from one clear workspace.
dashboard.workspaceTitle: From plugin ecosystem to Agent Runtime
dashboard.workspaceBody: HarnessHub brings plugin sources, Runtime status, and user consent into one desktop workspace.
dashboard.noActivity: Runtime activity will appear here. There are no events yet.

runtimeBridge.title: Agent Runtime
runtimeBridge.description: Connect HarnessHub Desktop to a controlled DSH contract fixture and validate start, stop, state synchronization, events, and audit.
runtimeBridge.previewDescription: View local Runtime connection, status, activity, and safety boundaries in HarnessHub Desktop.
runtimeBridge.fixtureTitle: This is a test Runtime, not real DSH
runtimeBridge.fixtureBody: It cannot call a model, run an Agent, install a plugin, start an OS process, or change your environment.
runtimeBridge.previewTitle: This is a safe Runtime preview
runtimeBridge.previewBody: You can try connection, start, stop, and activity history. Models, Agents, and plugin installation remain disabled.
runtimeBridge.realDescription: Start, stop, and open the real local DSH Runtime managed in HarnessHub's isolated environment.
runtimeBridge.realBody: The Runtime listens on a random loopback port, uses an isolated DSH_HOME, and has telemetry disabled. DSH still owns Agent and model permissions.
runtimeBridge.noEvents: Validated state events appear here after the Runtime preview starts.
runtimeBridge.noRealEvents: Validated runtime events appear here after the local Runtime starts.
runtimeBridge.connectionFailed: The local Runtime preview could not connect. No real Runtime was started.
runtimeBridge.operationFailed: The Runtime operation failed and was not presented as success.

installation.title: Safe installation flow demo
installation.description: Validate analysis, permission review, a simulated transaction, and recovery states. No plugin, script, or system setting is touched.
installation.simulationOnly: A simulated result does not mean the plugin was really installed
installation.signInTitle: Sign in to start the simulation
installation.signInBody: Installation transactions must belong to an authenticated user. The prototype enforces the same boundary.
installation.riskReason: Declares project file access and install-time code. The demo will not execute either capability.
installation.reasonNetworkAccess: Connect to the service declared by the plugin
installation.reasonProjectFileRead: Read content in the project you select
installation.reasonProjectFileWrite: Modify content in the project you select
installation.reasonShellExecution: Run commands required by the plugin
installation.reasonInstallTimeCode: Prepare plugin files; this demo shows the warning but never executes it
installation.reasonTelemetry: Send diagnostics or usage information to the service declared by the plugin
installation.resultInstalled: The simulated flow completed. No file or system state was changed.
installation.resultCancelled: Cancelled before execution. No installation action occurred.
installation.resultRolledBack: The simulated failure entered rollback and completed it.
installation.resultRecoveryRequired: The simulated rollback failed. Recovery is explicitly required and the result is not presented as success.
installation.auditEmpty: State changes appear here after analysis starts.
installation.unauthorized: The current user cannot access this simulated transaction.

runtime.title: Runtime and DSH status
runtime.description: Detect this device's operating system, architecture, Node.js, Git, and DSH. Detection never installs software or changes the system.
runtime.readOnlyBody: Only Node.js, Git, and DSH version queries are allowed. User commands, paths, and extra arguments are not accepted.
runtime.detectionFailed: Runtime detection could not finish. No installation or system change was attempted.
runtime.packagedOnly: Real environment detection is available only in the packaged HarnessHub Desktop. The web preview does not inspect your computer.
runtime.dshMissingHelp: HarnessHub can help prepare the AI Agent environment. Review the complete plan before deciding to continue.
runtime.planOnly: This is a plan and cannot execute
runtime.planOnlyBody: Confirmation only completes the Setup Assistant simulation. It does not download DSH, create a Profile, or run a command.
runtime.stepPrepareDshBody: Plan how an approved DSH release would be obtained.
runtime.stepCreateProfileBody: Plan an isolated HarnessHub user Profile.
runtime.permissions: Permissions required by a future real setup
runtime.permissionWhy: Why a future setup needs these permissions
runtime.willNotDo: Before you confirm: this will not
runtime.willNotRun: Run Shell commands, scripts, or third-party code
runtime.willNotChangeSystem: Change PATH, system settings, or existing files
runtime.permissionNetworkBody: A future setup may access the network for a pinned release artifact.
runtime.permissionProfileBody: A future setup may create an isolated HarnessHub Profile.
runtime.permissionRuntimeBody: A future setup may run only an allowlisted DSH verification operation.
runtime.confirmedBody: The plan was confirmed, but nothing was downloaded, installed, executed, or changed.
runtime.trustedBoundaryBody: Future evaluation is limited to official test plugins, LOW risk, a complete Manifest, and a Verified Developer. HIGH/CRITICAL cannot be automatically installed.
runtime.futureEligibleNoAuto: Eligible for a future controlled evaluation; automatic installation remains disabled.
runtime.futureBlocked: This candidate does not meet the future controlled-install boundary.

plugin.candidateSecurityTitle: Awaiting source checks and security analysis
plugin.candidateSecurityNotice: This project was automatically discovered from a public source and has not received human security review. Source snapshots and automated risk assessments are retained.
plugin.candidateRiskNotice: Unverified does not mean blocked. Every unverified plugin can be installed after two explicit risk confirmations.
plugin.reasonDangerousLifecycle: A dangerous package lifecycle-script pattern was detected.
plugin.reasonHighImpactCapability: A capability that may affect the system, credentials, or project content was detected.
plugin.reasonIncompleteEvidence: Pinned version, integrity hash, or Git commit evidence is incomplete.
plugin.reasonDeclaredPermissions: Runtime permissions requiring user review were detected.
plugin.reasonNoHighRiskSignal: No high-risk signal was detected in the currently collected metadata.
plugin.reasonLicenseMissing: A clear license has not been identified.
plugin.reasonScriptsDisabled: The package declares install scripts; HarnessHub forcibly disables them during installation.
plugin.reasonAutomatedAssessment: This is an automated assessment, not a human safety certification.
plugin.upstreamUnavailable: Upstream unavailable. Historical snapshots remain available.
plugin.noSourceStatus: No production source status exists for this fixture.
plugin.permissionNotice: Permission analysis is intentionally outside the Registry phase. No safety conclusion is attached.
plugin.sourceIdentityNotice: Source verification confirms repository, package name, and snapshot evidence. It is not a security review or developer verification.
plugin.readmeUnavailable: This snapshot does not yet contain a README excerpt. Use the source link to read the author's original content.
plugin.snapshotNotReview: Source snapshot, not a safety review
plugin.testFixtureNotice: This record is test-only and must not enter the production Registry.
plugin.snapshotNotice: HarnessHub cross-checked the listed GitHub and npm identities at the recorded time. No install action, safety endorsement, or developer verification is attached.

managedInstall.title: Install into local DSH
managedInstall.subtitle: Isolated Profile · install scripts disabled · two confirmations for unverified plugins
managedInstall.notDesktop: Install from HarnessHub Desktop. The web app never changes this computer.
managedInstall.signIn: Sign-in is only needed to sync installation history; it does not block local installation.
managedInstall.guestLocal: Guest mode: installation and audit records stay on this device. Sign in later to enable cloud sync.
managedInstall.runtimeRequired: Prepare DSH from the Runtime page first.
managedInstall.unavailable: This source does not yet include pinned, installable DSH Bundle evidence, so it cannot be installed safely. You can still browse its source and risk information.
managedInstall.candidateBlocked: This plugin requires two explicit risk confirmations.
managedInstall.candidatePending: Source collected · waiting for installable Bundle evidence
managedInstall.candidateRiskNotice: This plugin was automatically discovered and has not received human review. Once it has pinned DSH Bundle evidence, any user may install it after two explicit risk confirmations.
managedInstall.candidateEvidenceMissing: This source does not yet have pinned version, integrity, and Bundle manifest evidence.
managedInstall.sourceResolution: After confirmation, HarnessHub uses its saved pinned version, integrity, and Bundle manifest evidence to install in the isolated directory without running install scripts.
managedInstall.disabledRepair: This plugin was safely disabled for the current Runtime. You can still uninstall it. Reason: {{reason}}
managedInstall.sourceChanged: The source record or local dependency changed
managedInstall.criticalBlocked: Automated analysis classified this plugin as critical risk. Two explicit confirmations are required.
managedInstall.integrity: npm sha512 integrity is verified and install scripts are disabled.
managedInstall.confirmLabel: I reviewed the source, version, compatibility, and permission information and approve writing to the isolated HarnessHub directory.
managedInstall.confirmLow: I reviewed the pinned version, source, and integrity evidence and approve installation into the isolated HarnessHub directory.
managedInstall.confirmPermissions: I reviewed this plugin's permissions, risk level, and automated assessment.
managedInstall.confirmHigh: I understand that this plugin may be unverified or high risk and explicitly choose to continue.
managedInstall.confirmRemove: I confirm removing this plugin from the isolated HarnessHub Runtime.
managedInstall.restart: Runtime is running; changes load after restart.
managedInstall.failed: The operation did not complete and is never presented as success.

runtimeSetup.isolatedBody: HarnessHub uses its own Node.js, pnpm, and DSH_HOME without relying on or modifying the system toolchain.
runtimeSetup.prepareBody: Node.js and pnpm do not need to be preinstalled. HarnessHub prepares a pinned, hash-verified toolchain before creating the DSH web Profile.
runtimeSetup.downloadStep: Download pinned Node.js 22.19.0, pnpm 11.19.0, and official DSH 0.1.0-rc.8, verifying each artifact.
runtimeSetup.isolatedStep: Everything stays in HarnessHub app data; global PATH, Node.js, and pnpm remain unchanged.
runtimeSetup.safeStep: No user shell or unknown package is executed, and no Agent, plugin, or model request is started.
runtimeSetup.confirmLabel: I understand that HarnessHub will create an isolated toolchain and approve preparing DSH Runtime.
runtimeSetup.preparing: Preparing the isolated toolchain and validating DSH…
runtimeSetup.timeHint: First-time setup downloads about 60 MB and usually takes 1–3 minutes; the window remains usable.

managedPlugins.title: Installed plugin management
managedPlugins.body: This list comes from local installation records. A plugin can still be safely removed if it leaves the marketplace or its Registry ID changes. The Runtime is stopped before removal.
managedPlugins.empty: No third-party plugin is installed in this isolated Runtime.
